Hello Reservations Team
My name is mennatallah I am looking to rent 2 bedroom apartment in Dubai for long term duration check in 19 September 2026 till 18 September 2027 I want to pay on a monthly basis , furnished apartment clean and preferably brand new for kitchen and washroom or at least in a very good condition,  I am flexible if the duration is too long I can rent at least 4 month then renew its OK for me, I hold golden visa and my son as well.. my budget is between 8,000 to 10,000 per month and I know i will pay admin fees and deposit fees .. thanks in advance
